title: Haunted Sub Vigil
description: A slow-burn, bass-led future-garage cut: a deep rolling sub paces a sparse half-time 2-step while a chopped, pitch-shifted soul vocal haunts the space above. Sidechained pads breathe under the kick, skip hats and a garage rim creep in, and the filter slowly opens toward a nocturnal, dreamy peak before stripping back down.
code:
setcpm(129/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(280).gain(0.85),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [c3,eb3,bb3]>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.7)).lpf(perlin.range(500,1100).slow(8)).room(0.6).gain(0.5)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.9),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(300,520).slow(8)).gain(0.9),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.25,0.85)).lpf(perlin.range(600,1400).slow(8)).room(0.6).gain(0.5),
    s("hh(3,8,2)").bank("OberheimDMX").cut(1).gain(0.45).hpf(7000)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.95),
    s("~ rim ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).room(0.3),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(320,600).slow(16)).shape(0.25).gain(0.95),
    s("think").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 ~ 6 ~ 3 5").speed("<1 1.5 0.5>").vowel("<a e o>").room(0.5).delay(".4:.166:.5").gain(0.6),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.25,0.9)).lpf(perlin.range(800,1800).slow(16)).room(0.5).gain(0.5),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("OberheimDMX").cut(1).gain(0.5).hpf(8000)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(260,480).slow(16)).gain(0.85),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3]>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.85)).lpf(perlin.range(500,1300).slow(16)).room(0.7).delay(".5:.25:.6").crush(8).gain(0.5),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 3 ~ 5 ~ 2 ~").speed("<0.5 1>").room(0.7).delay(".5:.25:.55").gain(0.45)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 1 2>")).gain(0.95),
    s("~ rim ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).room(0.3),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).room(0.4),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)).lpf(perlin.range(380,720).slow(16)).shape(0.3).gain(0.95),
    s("think").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 6 7 5 3 1").speed("<1 1.5 0.5 2>").vowel("<a e o i>").sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.crush(6)).room(0.5).delay(".4:.166:.5").gain(0.6),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.25,0.95)).lpf(perlin.range(1000,2600).slow(16)).room(0.5).gain(0.5),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("OberheimDMX").cut(1).every(4, x => x.rev()).gain(0.5).hpf(8500)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [14, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(240,420).slow(16)).gain(0.8),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [c3,eb3,bb3]>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.6)).lpf(perlin.range(400,900).slow(8)).room(0.75).delay(".5:.25:.6").gain(0.45),
    s("breath").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ ~ 4 ~ ~ 6 ~").speed(0.8).room(0.8).delay(".5:.25:.5").gain(0.4)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)]
)
